test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-5) Official Paper (Held On: 12 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
There are 3 badminton players in each stream-Commerce, Science and Arts. A, B and C are from Commerce. P, Q and R are from Science. J, K and L are from Arts. A team of 4 badminton players are to be sent for a tournament with following conditions:

(i) There must be at least one student from each stream.

(ii) P will not go with Q or R.

(iii) A and C will always go together.

(iv) K and L will always go together.

Which of the following combinations of players is a possible combination for the tournament?
solution:
Given:

3 badminton players in each stream Commerce, Science and Arts.

Commerce: A, B and C

Science: P, Q and R

Arts: J, K and L

A team of 4 badminton players are to be sent for a tournament with following conditions:

(i) There must be at least one student from each stream.

 
 

 
 
**Commerce**

 
 
 
**Science**

 
 
 
**Art**

 
 
 

 
 
A / B / C

 
 
 
P / Q / R

 
 
 
J / K / L

 
 
 

 

(ii) P will not go with Q or R.

 
 

 
 
**Commerce**

 
 
 
**Science**

 
 
 
**Art**

 
 
 

 
 
A / B / C

 
 
 
P or (Q / R)

 
 
 
J / K / L

 
 
 

 

(iii) A and C will always go together.

 
 

 
 
**Commerce**

 
 
 
**Science**

 
 
 
**Art**

 
 
 

 
 
B / (A + C)

 
 
 
P or (Q / R)

 
 
 
J / K / L

 
 
 

 

(iv) K and L will always go together.

 
 

 
 
**Commerce**

 
 
 
**Science**

 
 
 
**Art**

 
 
 

 
 
B or (A + C)

 
 
 
P or (Q / R)

 
 
 
J or (K + L)

 
 
 

 

Now check all the options:

1) A, C, P, and J → True (All conditions are fulfilled)

2) A, Q, R, and J → False (A and C will always go together)

3) B, Q, J, and K → False (K and L will always go together)

4) B, P, R, and J → False (P will not go with Q or R)

Hence, **“Option (1)”** is the correct answer.
